parts.text:
create a small pdf for me

Quick refresh — you vibecoded ImpactaStore (/home/giroto/DevFaculdade/Estagio/ImpactaStore) and lost track of the flow. Here's where we are:

1. Project flow (MVC) — how a request actually works: routes/web.php:8 GET / -> app/Http/Controllers/HomeController.php:9 index() -> app/Models/Game.php:7 Game::where('status','approved') -> PostgreSQL impacta.games -> resources/views/home.blade.php:20 renders hero + games-track. Same for upload: GET /games/upload -> GameController.php:11 create() -> form games/create.blade.php:51 POST /games -> GameController.php:17 store() validates + Game::create() (status = pending/approved) -> redirect home with success. GET /jogos -> GameController.php:77 index() -> games/index.blade.php. GET /admin -> AdminController.php:9 index() -> moderates status (pending/approved/rejected).


2. Database / Banco de Dados:


Domain is just users (id, name, email, password) + games (id, user_id FK -> users.id nullable(), title, cover_image, iframe_url, description, genres, status) — database/migrations/0001_01_01_000000_create_users_table.php:9 + 2026_06_23_200016_create_games_table.php:14. We removed Laravel defaults: cache/jobs migrations and password_reset_tokens/sessions tables + switched .env:30 SESSION_DRIVER=database to file, CACHE_STORE to file, QUEUE_CONNECTION to sync. DER is now clean 1:N in pgModeler (users ||--o{ games : cadastra). migrations table is just Laval's log — safe to hide from diagram.
MER vs DER: MER = conceptual (Chen diamonds/ovals), DER = physical (pgModeler tables/types/constraints). Class Diagram = POO mapping: <<entity>> User/Game (Models), <<control>> GameController/AdminController, <<boundary>> GameView/Blade (no methods needed per your friend's tip).
3. What we cleaned/built:


Removed unused Laravel Breeze boilerplate: routes/auth.php, app/Http/Controllers/Auth/*, ProfileController.php, Requests/Auth/*, views/auth/*, views/profile/*, tests/Feature/Auth/*.
Backup originally at ImpactaStore_backup (you recreated via GNOME).
Docs: Changelogs/ + Changelogs/ESTUDOS/ .odt files (MER/DER/PK/FK/ECB).
UI: Fixed logo.gif luma-key transparency (home.blade.php:8 SVG filter #remove-black + home.css:45 filter:url(#remove-black)), fixed fullscreen WebGL swirl on layouts/app.blade.php:12 canvas#ditherShaderCanvas (vanilla WebGL2, no React/npm added — stays Laravel+Vite), + glossy header/footer removed backdrop-filter for performance.
To truly own it: pick GameController.php:17 store() and routes/web.php and trace line-by-line without AI, then break it intentionally (remove fillable, break validation) and fix via php artisan errors.
